headline: OpenAI launches a cybersecurity model as AI finds more bugs
script: OpenAI has released a new model built for cybersecurity work. It is called ChatGPT Cyber and goes first to the top tier of Daybreak Red. That program gives offensive researchers tools to hunt for vulnerabilities. A vulnerability is a flaw in software that attackers can abuse. The news follows a striking find by Max Justicz of Charge Robotics. He aimed GPT 5.6 Sol at Ubuntu code and found a severe flaw in two hours. Ubuntu is a widely used open source operating system. He reported it to the Debian Project, which issued a patch. There is no known evidence that anyone exploited the flaw. OpenAI said the same model scanned the Linux kernel and found nine hundred forty-eight potential issues. It also found eighty-one new vulnerabilities in the Firefox browser. OpenAI says defenders have a narrow window before AI hacking improves and spreads. Justicz spent about five thousand dollars on subscriptions and tokens to find several exploits.

terms.note: 指软件中可被攻击者利用的安全缺陷。
指源代码公开、任何人都能查看和修改的软件。
指用来修复已知漏洞的小型软件更新。
指Linux操作系统的核心部分，负责管理硬件和进程。
指使用AI模型时按用量计费的调用单位。

grammar.note: 英文用被动说明名称，中文常说“它名为”，容易误写成主动句。

grammar.point: 非限制性定语从句 which issued a patch
grammar.note: which指代前面的Debian项目，中文要拆成“该项目随后……”而不能直译成一个长定语。

grammar.point: before加从句 before AI hacking improves
grammar.note: before后接完整从句表示“在……之前”，中文习惯用“之前”而容易漏掉主语和动词。

questions.q: How long did it take Justicz to find the severe flaw?
questions.explain: 第六句说他两小时内就找到了这个严重缺陷。

questions.q: How many potential issues did the model find in the Linux kernel?
questions.explain: 第十句给出Linux内核的潜在问题数量是九百四十八个。
